visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Hide the Balance Behind Functions
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The balance is a public property that any code can overwrite, and the rules are repeated at the call site. Wrap it in a closure with deposit and withdraw functions. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Outside code can no longer set the balance to a nonsense value, because the only ways to change it are the deposit and withdraw functions, and the withdrawal rule lives in one place.
